title: Inland American Board of Directors Approves Spin-off of Xenia Hotels & Resorts, Inc.
summary: Inland Anticipates the Separation of Xenia to occur on February 3, 2015 with a listing on the NYSE to follow on February 4, 2015 for Xenia Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc. (Inland American) today announced that its Board of Directors has formally authorized the distribution of 95% of the shares of common stock of Xenia Hotels Resorts, Inc. (Xenia), a wholly owned subsidiary of Inland American, to its stockholders. Following the distribution, Xenia will be a self-managed, publicly traded real estate investment trust (REIT) listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the symbol (XHR) focused on investing in premium full service, lifestyle and urban upscale hotels in the top 25 U.S. lodging markets and key leisure destinations throughout the United States.
